tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish a program providing rebates for consumers for expenditures made for the installation of a renewable energy system in connection with a dwelling unit or small business.

tree.heading: Amount of rebate
tree.text: Rebates provided under the program established under paragraph (1) shall be in an amount not to exceed the lesser of—

children.text: 25 percent of the expenditures described in paragraph (1) made by the consumer; or

tree.heading: Definition
tree.text: For purposes of this section, the term “renewable energy system” has the meaning given that term in section 6865(c)(6)(A) of this title.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary for carrying out this section, to remain available until expended—
